Additionally, Bleomycin is also indicated for Primary Cutaneous Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma, which is linked to Dexamethasone, and Dexamethasone is associated with Plasmablastic Lymphoma. While the evidence is consistent across different indications, the strength of the relationship varies, with Bleomycin showing a higher score in the first path compared to the second.
